page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top centre, page number at top right; a decorative rule and a large heading below the verse; a woodcut initial opens the final stanza.

main_text.p:
Oppositas patientur æquas.
Gens bellicosa, & libera liberos
Seruire ciues non feret: asperum
Bello Geneuam qui lacesset
Helvetium experietur hostem.
Qualis superbos non vice simplici
Burgundionum contudit impetus,
Qualisve saeui cum Tyranni
Obsequium imperiis negauit.
Nostris paratas, Nate, laboribus
Paces habe, inquam, pluraque dicerem,
Sed longioris fila vitae
Rumpere iam properant, sorores.
main_text.head: FRANCISCO NOVÆO NOBILI GALLO QVVM LIBERATUS Hispanorum carcere Geneuam venit Anno 1586.
main_text.p:
Vis claustra tetri carceris abdita,
Quis vincla tandem rupit ahenea,
Plures quis amissum per annos
Restituit reducem Nouaeum?
Nam te cauernis luce carentibus
Vinctum, seueris excubiis Iber
Horrens tenebat, ne solutus

page.notes: The decorative rule and the woodcut initial Q are ornaments, not text. The heading is set in mixed capitals and roman type; the Latin line breaks in the heading are approximate. Verse lines are rendered with line breaks inside a paragraph. The letters "ꝙ" in "QVVM" are read as printed.
